links.outcome: Whether domain expert involvement in AI model development catches data bias and leakage
links.effect: Expert oversight directed the AI agent to new concept categories, adjusted concept granularity, and identified data bias and leakage. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: HACHI also highlights the critical role of human oversight, such as in directing the AI agent to explore new concept categories, adjusting concept granularity, and identifying data bias and leakage.

unlisted_practices: Iterative human-in-the-loop co-design of interpretable clinical prediction models with an AI agent exploring concepts from clinical notes

screen.reason: Empirically tests an iterative human-in-the-loop co-design framework (HACHI) where clinical experts provide feedback and oversight to steer an AI agent building interpretable prediction models from clinical notes.
